description: This file contains the implementation of the ModuleInstaller class in Drupal, responsible for installing and uninstalling modules, managing dependencies, schema, configuration, and updating the kernel accordingly.

classes.name: ModuleInstaller
classes.description: Implements module installation and uninstallation logic, dependency management, schema handling, configuration, and kernel updates in Drupal.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs a list of modules, handling dependencies, schema, configuration, and kernel updates.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls specified modules, handling dependencies, schema removal, configuration cleanup, and kernel updates.

methods.name: validateUninstall
methods.description: Validates whether modules can be uninstalled, returning reasons if not.

methods.name: addUninstallValidator
methods.description: Adds a validator for uninstalling modules (deprecated in favor of constructor injection).

methods.name: installSchema
methods.description: Creates database tables defined in a module's hook_schema().

methods.name: uninstallSchema
methods.description: Removes database tables defined in a module's hook_schema().

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Calls a procedural hook function in an installed module.

methods.name: removeCacheBins
methods.description: Removes cache bins registered by a specific module.

methods.name: updateKernel
methods.description: Rebuilds the Drupal kernel with the current list of modules.
